nodes.label: Exp435 prediction boundary
nodes.role: Groups the frozen Exp435 configuration/contracts, descriptor-bound label-free input session, TRAIN-only feature calibration, CPU consensus scoring, candidate budget and optional MLX readiness gate.
constraints: FROZEN_CONFIG.validate() must pass before input access
Exactly 1,117 sorted unique datasets come from the frozen Exp291/292 lane population
The held Exp425 descriptor is read-only and closes on every exit path
Prediction intake exposes TRAIN values and TEST values only; no TEST labels are loaded
Exp435 TEST values are requested only after a concrete RawTrainDataset is loaded
Published records and backend evidence are immutable and fail closed on contract mismatch
Exact-length TRAIN groups retain duplicate rows and sorted instance coordinates
Invalid TRAIN groups emit immutable UnavailableTrainGroup records with preregistered reasons; valid sibling groups continue
Prototype uses TRAIN-only float32 robust scaling and leave-one-out higher-quantile calibration; gradient and ACF are optional channels
CPU scoring routes each TEST value row to one exact raw-length TRAIN group; missing or unavailable lengths abstain without concatenation or tail replacement
A candidate requires prototype AND (gradient OR ACF) with strict score > threshold; frozen-lane coordinates are excluded
Global candidate validation sorts coordinates and fails closed above 100; it never truncates or auto-promotes

MLX is optional and lazy; readiness uses exactly one query row per channel score call, preserves the frozen reference batch sizes, and adopted runtime/device/output failure fails closed without CPU-score mixing
MLX dense scoring keeps exact float32 inputs and checks finite outputs, normalized/absolute score error <=1e-5 and exact candidate coordinates for every batch size 16, 32, 64, 128 and 256
Each MLX gate batch performs 2 warmups and 5 timed measurements including evaluation and synchronization; adoption requires speedup >=1.1
BackendBatchEvidence preserves per-batch parity, finite-output, candidate, timing and reason records; BackendDecision binds selected batch evidence to MLX/Metal/device provenance
UnavailableTrainGroup, TrainGroup and CalibratedTrainGroupResult remain public contract exports for feature/scoring consumers.
Exp435FrozenConfig supplies the sole canonical run identity exp435-train-only-consensus-recovery-antigravity-20260806 for readiness and all runtime artifacts.

nodes.label: Exp435 five-mode CLI + resumable runtime
nodes.role: Fixed five-mode CLI (readiness/new/resume/inspect/evaluate) validates clean HEAD and delayed imports, runs or resumes the label-free scorer with parent-owned inputs, and delegates evaluate only at a lazy boundary; publication and replay remain verified read-only operations.
constraints: CLI parser accepts exactly readiness, new, resume, inspect and evaluate; alternate paths are rejected
Readiness requires clean initial and final HEAD, absent fixed output/checkpoint/evaluation roots and an empty fixed parent; one writer persists byte-identical canonical readiness
New validates readiness, imports input/runtime dependencies before the final HEAD read, then binds that exact commit before opening the input session
Unfinished resume imports runtime/input dependencies and rechecks final HEAD immediately before opening the input session; completed or repeated resume replays read-only without DB or workers
Evaluation is imported and delegated lazily only for evaluate; implementation and post-freeze TEST-label loading are grouped in exp435_checkpoint_progress; prediction modes never import it
CPU uses ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=7) with at most seven submitted/in-flight futures; queued work is never reported as current.
LaneMembershipSnapshot is immutable and pickle-safe before workers start
Parent alone owns the verified input session, checkpoint, progress and logs; commits remain dataset-name ordered
Adopted MLX uses one process and no outer scoring pool
Candidate-budget overflow is persisted before any record/publication and fails closed
Runtime/checkpoint/progress/publication bind the exact frozen run identity, checkpoint path, backend, dataset total and context fingerprint; no commit/hash-derived identity is accepted.
Workers receive values-only objects and never access labels, SQLite descriptors or durable outputs
Existing publications are inspected read-only and summarized without reopening the database

Production evaluate is bound to the exact FROZEN_OUTPUT and FROZEN_EVALUATION sibling paths under RUN_PARENT; helper evaluation roots must also be absent, separate and outside output/publication/checkpoint.
The direct scratch runner bootstraps the repository root before importing experiments and exposes exactly five modes; an outside-cwd --help subprocess regression protects the documented entrypoint.
The runbook records readiness, prediction, replay, evaluation, interrupted and failed states with fixed CLI return-code behavior.
Failed roots reject resume read-only before input access, PID/progress/event mutation; interrupted roots remain resumable after binding checks.
Parallel current_dataset denotes only loading/dispatching, a submitted result not yet collected by the parent, or committing work; parallel stages never assert unobserved worker scoring.

nodes.label: Exp435 checkpoint, publication + retrospective evaluation
nodes.role: Persists canonical records and atomic progress/PID/events logs, replays a checkpoint_complete runtime into eight no-clobber review-only artifacts, and evaluates only after independent publication/hash verification.
constraints: Atomic no-clobber records and record-set digest are fsynced; commit intent recovery is deterministic
Candidate budget is checked before writing an over-budget record and publication rejects totals above 100 without truncation
Only interrupted/nonterminal roots may reconcile exact internal progress/PID temps; failed durable state rejects read-only before any cleanup or PID/progress/event mutation.
Progress, PID and events bind one canonical checkpoint path, backend, total 1,117, run identity and context fingerprint
Inspection opens no database or worker and validates outputs, events, label firewall and counter conservation read-only
Durable progress and logs never contain TEST values or labels
Publication accepts checkpoint_complete runtime state only and requires exact success/abstention/error counter conservation
The publication inventory is exactly the eight review-only files; its SHA map is self-excluded
Manifest, status and artifact SHA maps bind the four terminal runtime files by SHA256
Publication staging is fsynced and moved with Darwin RENAME_EXCL so an appearing destination is never replaced
Published outputs are review_only, operational_alert_eligible=false, contain no TEST labels and are independently replay-verified
Retrospective evaluation replays publication and validates population, input/code/config hashes before opening TEST labels
TEST labels are loaded only in evaluation_antigravity.py after the hash gate; prediction modules never import the loader
Hard versus Hard+Exp435 metrics are paired by dataset; rescued, regression and strong-baseline lists remain review-only
Bootstrap uses 20,000 paired dataset clusters with seed 43520260806 and percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals
Evaluation artifacts are canonical, staged and no-clobber under a separate evaluation_antigravity root
Production evaluation accepts only the exact fixed CLI FROZEN_OUTPUT/FROZEN_EVALUATION siblings; helper roots reject equal or nested output, publication or checkpoint paths.
Before TEST labels, the Exp404 SHA and Exp291 SHA are frozen and the comparator verifies 888 Exp404 datasets, 2,218 coordinates and the 229-dataset empty complement across all 1,117 datasets.

One Exp417 descriptor-bound verified read-only SQLite connection opens the exact hashed inode after the hash gate, loads only instance_index and label, then closes once; prediction remains label-free.
The complete frozen output tree is snapshotted before labels and re-inspected immediately before the staged evaluation no-clobber rename; any source mutation fails closed.
Evaluation payload state is evaluated and combined confusion counts preserve the monotonic union invariants: TP/FP do not decrease and FN/TN do not increase.
Exp404 and Exp291 comparator artifacts are each captured through one O_NOFOLLOW descriptor, then bytes, SHA256 and parse use that same capture.

flows.label: Exp435 clean-HEAD readiness
flows.trigger: Run the fixed readiness mode before any prediction roots exist.
flows.outcome: The CLI checks clean HEAD, frozen canonical identity and inputs, requires absent fixed roots, benchmarks the exact one-query-row MLX scoring granularity across frozen reference batch sizes, then writes one canonical readiness artifact. Adoption is immutable for the run; runtime MLX failure fails closed rather than mixing CPU scores.

flows.label: Exp435 new/resume label-free prediction
flows.trigger: Invoke new after readiness or resume an unfinished checkpoint.
flows.outcome: New binds the canonical identity and final clean commit before the descriptor-bound session; unfinished interrupted resume rechecks those bindings, while failed roots reject read-only before input/PID/progress/event mutation. The parent loads TRAIN then values-only TEST, submits at most seven CPU futures, records only parent-observable dispatch/result/commit stages, and commits dataset-name order.

flows.label: Exp435 checkpoint_complete publication
flows.trigger: A checkpoint_complete runtime has 1,117 records, <=100 candidates, inactive PID, null current dataset and the four terminal runtime files.
flows.outcome: Replay validates counter conservation and label-free fields, binds eight artifact files plus four terminal runtime SHA256 values, and publishes review-only artifacts with atomic Darwin RENAME_EXCL without clobbering a destination.

flows.label: Exp435 inspect/repeated resume replay
flows.trigger: inspect or repeated resume sees an existing publication or a completed checkpoint.
flows.outcome: The CLI opens checkpoint/publication data read-only, replays and compares canonical bytes and hashes, and does not reopen the database, input session or workers.

flows.label: Exp435 hash-gated retrospective evaluation
flows.trigger: The operator explicitly selects evaluate only after the label-free prediction, manifest and artifact hashes are frozen at the fixed production sibling paths.
flows.outcome: The CLI lazily imports the evaluator; it replays read-only checkpoint/publication, validates fixed sibling paths and population/code/input/config hashes, captures Exp404 and Exp291 through O_NOFOLLOW descriptors for same-byte SHA256/parse equality, then imports Exp417 verified_read_only_connection to open one exact hashed SQLite inode for instance_index/label. It snapshots/re-inspects output before staged no-clobber evaluation publication; prediction bytes remain unchanged.
